notice.subject: FORCE MAJEURE-COMP STA 168
notice.body_text:
FORCE MAJEURE – COMPRESSOR STATION 168

 

Natural has experienced
horsepower issues at Compressor Station 168 (CS 168) located in Bailey County,
Texas (Segment 8 of Natural's Permian Zone).  This is a Force Majeure
event.  Natural is required to reduce the maximum operating capacity
northbound into Segment 8 from Segment 9, thus limiting Natural's throughput
capacity northbound through Compressor Station 167 (CS 167).

 

The scheduling constraint
will be Segment 9 at CS 167; therefore, any gas received south of CS 167 for
delivery north of CS 167 will be impacted for the duration of the
restriction.  The Pooling Point - Permian Zone (LOC 25077) is located
south of the constraint.  Firm transportation associated with storage
withdrawals may be impacted.

 

As such, effective for gas
day 
Tuesday, April 7, 2026, Timely
Cycle and continuing until further notice
, Natural will schedule Primary Firm and Secondary in-path Firm
transports to no less than 
94%
 of contract MDQ through CS 167.  AOR/ITS and
Secondary out-of-path Firm transports 
will not
 be available for the
duration of this restriction.

 

Additionally, the unit
maintenance referenced on Natural's Outage Impact Report (X26-220667) has been
postponed until further notice
.

 

The stated scheduling
percentage is based upon the current level of firm capacity contracted for
during this restriction and is subject to change based upon operational
conditions and Shipper utilization.

 

Continue to monitor Natural's
interactive website for any updates to the end date during this
restriction.  Please contact your Account Director or Scheduling
Representative if you have any questions.

ANR/NGPL SOUTH JOLIET AT CAPACITY SEGMENT 25 – STATION MAINTENANCE – CS 302 As posted on Natural's Outage Impact Report (X25-1527903), Natural will be performing station maintenance at Compressor Station 302 (CS 302) located in Montgomery County, Texas (Segment 25 of Natural's Texok Zone). Natural is required to reduce the maximum operating capacity eastbound into Segment 25 from Segment 26 and Segment 22, thus limiting Natural's throughput capacity eastbound through CS 302 during this restriction. The scheduling constraint will be at CS 302 ; therefore, any gas received west of CS 302 for delivery east of CS 302 will be impacted for the duration of the restriction. The Pooling Point - Texok Zone (LOC 10560) is located west of the constraint. Firm transportation associated with storage withdrawals may be impacted. As such, effective for gas day Wednesday, April 1, 2026, Timely Cycle, and continuing through gas day Friday, May 1, 2026 , Natural will schedule Primary Firm and Secondary in-path Firm transports to no less than 55% of contract MDQ through CS 302. AOR/ITS and Secondary out-of-path Firm transports will not be available for the duration of this restriction. The stated scheduling percentage is based upon the current level of firm capacity contracted for during this restriction and is subject to change based upon operational conditions and Shipper utilization. Continue to monitor Natural's interactive website for any updates. Please contact your Account Director or Scheduling Representative if you have any questions. ..

ANR/NGPL SOUTH JOLIET AT CAPACITY FLORIDA VERMILION (LOC 7936) – PRIMARY ONLY Due to current operating conditions, effective for gas day Wednesday, January 14, 2026, Timely Cycle and continuing until further notice, Florida Vermilion (LOC 7936) is at operating capacity. As such, Natural will only schedule Primary Firm transports for deliveries to Florida Vermilion (LOC 7936). AOR/ITS, Secondary out-of-path Firm transports and Secondary in-path Firm transports will not be available. Florida Vermilion is located in Vermilion Parish, Louisiana (Segment 24), in Natural's Louisiana Zone. Please contact your Account Director or Scheduling Representative if you have any questions. ..

STATION 302 – REPLACE REGULATOR – UPDATE PHMSA MEGA RULE–- ELIGIBLE PROJECT - SEGMENT 13 – AMARILLO #3 M/L – CS 107/108 – ILI TOOL RUNS In accordance with its FERC Gas Tariff and as posted on Natural's Outage Impact Report (X25-1166550) ; as part of Natural's ongoing pipeline Integrity Management Program, Natural will perform a series of ILI tool runs on its Amarillo #3 mainline between Compressor Station 107 (CS 107) located in Mills County, Iowa and Compressor Station 108 (CS 108) located in Warren County, Iowa (Segment 13 of Natural's Amarillo Mainline Zone). The tool runs will require Natural to reduce the operating capacity, thus limiting Natural's throughput capacity northbound through CS 108. Once the data from the tool runs have been analyzed, any remediation work impacting shippers will be posted. This remediation project is pursuant to the PHMSA Mega Rule and as set forth in its Tariff, is an Eligible Project (ID 4819) included on the Eligible Project List posted on Natural's internet website. See Eligible Project ID, line name and location identified below (Appendix F- Docket No. RP22-1222 Settlement). This outage is subject to the provisions of Section 5.2 (c) (5) of the General Terms and Conditions of Natural's FERC Gas Tariff. Project ID Line Name Location/Segment No. 4819 AMARILLO #3 MAINLINE SEGMENT 13 The scheduling constraint will be upstream of CS 108 at the beginning of Segment 13; therefore, any gas received south of Segment 13 for delivery north of Segment 13 will be impacted for the duration of the restriction. Receipts from Trailblazer Gage (LOC 902900) are south of CS 107 and will be impacted for the duration of the restriction. Northern Natural Mills (LOC 900203) is located downstream of the Segment 13 constraint location. For scheduling purposes, the Amarillo Pool (LOC 10566) is located south of the constraint. Additionally, firm transportation associated with storage withdrawals or injections may be impacted. As such, effective on the gas days indicated below, Natural will schedule Primary Firm and Secondary in-path Firm transports to no less than 44% of contract MDQ northbound through CS 107. AOR/ITS and Secondary out-of-path Firm transports will not be available for the duration of the restriction. TOOL RUN DATES : Gas day Friday, April 17, 2026 (Cleaning/ Gauge Tools) Gas day Tuesday, April 21, 2026 (Cleaning Tool) Gas day Thursday, April 23, 2026 (Cleaning Tool) Gas day Tuesday, April 28, 2026 (Combo Tool) Gas day Thursday, April 30, 2026 (EMAT Tool) Gas day Friday, May 1, 2026 (EMAT Tool) The stated scheduling percentage is based upon the current level of firm capacity contracted for during this restriction and is subject to change based upon operational conditions and Shipper utilization. Continue to monitor Natural's interactive website for any updates to the end date and/or scheduling percentage during this restriction. Please contact your Account Director or Scheduling Representative if you have any questions. ..
